nodes.description: Storage slot at keccak256("PROXIABLE") (0xc5f16f0fcc639fa48a6947836d9850f504798523bf8c9a3a87d5876cf622bcf7) that holds the delegatecall target / implementation address.
Constructor that persists the given logic contract address into the PROXIABLE storage slot using inline assembly sstore.
Payable fallback function that forwards all calldata and value to the stored implementation via delegatecall and bubbles up the return data or revert.
Inline-assembly delegatecall(gas, contractLogic, ptr, calldatasize, 0, 0) executing arbitrary external code in the storage context of this proxy.
Caller-supplied address preserved across the delegatecall, so the external implementation observes the proxy's caller as its own msg.sender.
Constructor parameter contractLogic: address of the initial implementation contract.
Assembly local variable in the fallback that holds the sload result of the PROXIABLE slot, used as the delegatecall target.

edges.reason: The constructor writes the implementation address into the PROXIABLE storage slot.
The contractLogic constructor parameter is the value sstored into the PROXIABLE storage slot.
The fallback reads the implementation address from the PROXIABLE storage slot via sload into the contractLogic local.
All calls reaching the fallback are routed into the assembly delegatecall block.
The address loaded from the PROXIABLE slot becomes the target argument of the delegatecall.
msg.sender is forwarded unchanged into the delegatecall, giving untrusted caller identity to the external implementation executed in the proxy context.
A delegatecall into arbitrary implementation logic can call back into this proxy, re-entering the fallback before the original call's effects are settled.

normalization_plan.reason: The non-core constructor parameter is only an input binding of the constructor function and is merged into it for normalization.
The assembly local holding the sloaded implementation address is directly consumed by the delegatecall unsafe operation and is merged into it.
